import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#ff7f0e', '#1f77b4'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
sns.kdeplot(data=df_age[df_age['survived']==1], x='age', ax=ax2, fill=True, alpha=0.5, label='Survived', color='#2ecc71')
sns.kdeplot(data=df_age[df_age['survived']==0], x='age', ax=ax2, fill=True, alpha=0.5, label='Did Not Survive', color='#e74c3c')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# Plot 3: Survival by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town').agg({
    'survived': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
embark_survival.columns = ['embark_town', 'survived', 'total']
embark_survival['not_survived'] = embark_survival['total'] - embark_survival['survived']
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()

x = range(len(embark_survival))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], embark_survival['survived'], width, label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = ax3.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], embark_survival['not_survived'], width, label='Did Not Survive', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(embark_survival['embark_town'], rotation=0)
ax3.legend(loc='upper right')
ax3.bar_label(bars1, fontsize=9)
ax3.bar_label(bars2, fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Fare distribution by class (box plot)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
palette = {1: '#3498db', 2: '#9b59b6', 3: '#e67e22'}
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax4, palette=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
handles, labels = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(handles, ['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
